## Accessibility manual sweep

- [ ] Tab through the full page at least once; every control has a visible focus ring and a sensible order.
- [ ] Check a 375px-wide viewport at 200% zoom; no content or controls are clipped or horizontally scrolled.
- [ ] Review a desaturated screenshot; no meaning depends on colour alone.
- [ ] Check both light and dark themes; neither is an afterthought.
- [ ] Check reduced motion when the change adds or changes animation.
